LanguageData.RHA_BloodTrial030_root.label: Seal the pact
LanguageData.RHA_BloodTrial030_root.description: Threat: A designated enemy frenzies for 8 seconds after actual damage reaches 20% of maximum torso health, exposing its weakness. Answer: Burst it down, trade hits or control it until frenzy ends; once per enemy per phase. Reward: It takes 25% more damage during frenzy, rewarding a saved burst. Cost: Frenzy makes ordinary attacks faster and raises outgoing damage by 25%. Arrangement: Anchor break; Locked impact. New first clears teach counters; refinements deepen coordination. Roles change no faster than every 30 seconds. Locked attacks never track; ordinary attacks and early kills work. Existing finite roster retained.
